item.description:
• **Password prompt, now inside Kegwatch**: when an update needs your administrator password, you're asked right in Kegwatch's own window instead of a separate system dialog — the same secure flow, just clearer about who's asking (your password is used only for that update and is never saved)
  • **Opens ready to work**: the window now scans automatically the first time you open it, instead of waiting for you to press Refresh
  • **A genuinely lighter Light theme**: the glassy background now adapts to your appearance, so Light mode looks properly light instead of muddy
  • **Better VoiceOver support**: update checkboxes, version changes, and info buttons now read clearly for screen-reader users
  • **Safer links and network checks**: Kegwatch only opens normal web links (http/https) from app update feeds, and network checks now time out and cap their size — hardening against misbehaving or malicious feeds
  • More consistent buttons across the Update and Install tabs
